_comment: `a.js` defers `t.js`, and `t.js` imports `a.js`. This cycle has a defer target, so both modules keep their wrappers and their state records (`__esmState`). `helper.js` is a private module of the deferred root `root.js`. `root.js` imports `a.js` before `helper.js`, so the wrapper of `root.js` calls the init of `a.js` before the body of `helper.js` (a pre-call).
